claude.sample_unit: texts (100 abstracts and 340 patient education materials)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FKRE) of texts before and after GPT-4 plain-language simplification
links.effect: FKGL decreased from 12th to 5th grade for abstracts and 13th to 5th for PEMs (p < 0.001); FKRE showed similar improvement (p < 0.001).
links.quote: FKGL decreased from 12th to 5th grade for abstracts and 13th to 5th for PEMs (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Content fidelity of simplified text versus original by LSA and expert assessment
links.effect: Expert mean topic similarity 0.775 for abstracts and 0.715 for PEMs; LSA cosine similarity 0.746 for abstracts and 0.953 for PEMs; LSA-expert correlation 0.598 (abstracts) and -0.167 (PEMs).
links.quote: Expert assessment indicated a mean topic similarity of 0.775 for abstracts and 0.715 for PEMs.

links.effect: Correlation was 0.48 (p = 0.02) below 450 words and -0.20 (p = 0.43) above 450 words.
links.quote: Segmented analysis of similarity correlations revealed a correlation of 0.48 (p = 0.02) below 450 words and a -0.20 (p = 0.43) correlation above 450 words.
